boundary: E2 controlled-runtime on the shipped profile registry in a loopback session; geometry and contrast of painted layout only, no claim that a target ran.
howItSettles: The screen writes its own state flag: #tp-combination carries data-mode = unspecified | partial | plan-only | target, and only a resolved profile sets target. The gate picks software, then Agent, then entry, then model and task mode -- skipping any picker with nothing to pick or a value already chosen -- and waits on that flag, not on "text appeared", because an honest empty answer also has text.
note: The combination screen does not push the topbar out of view (notInView=0 here), so the observation recorded in 5.44 stays specific to the long assistant screen.
